summary: Confirmed on FDACS's Croom Tract page and the Florida Forest Service's ReserveAmerica site: 34 sites with 50-amp electric and water, rigs to 60 ft, showers and dump station, open year round, ReserveAmerica booking from the same day to 11 months (the inherited state-parks 'operator' platform replaced by reserveamerica). Fees ($22.42, read 2026-10-12) left as recorded. AWH's note left alone (see waterfront flag).
flags: Policy inheritance: this Florida Forest Service campground inherits state:FL, the Florida State Parks row (Reserve Florida, 'operator' platform, its booking note about floridastateparks.org), which is a different agency and booking system. It needs its own explicit policy_ref (a Florida state forests row, or 'none'); this result records its own booking values, which covers it for now.
Missing phone: Withlacoochee State Forest headquarters is (352) 797-4140 (https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/State-Forests/Withlacoochee-State-Forest); reservations 1-877-879-3859.

Waterfront re-audit lead: FDACS says 'Campsites sit high above Silver Lake under the shade of oak and pine trees with several sites having a view of the water' (https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/State-Forests/Withlacoochee-State-Forest/Recreation-Areas-on-the-Croom-Tract-at-Withlacoochee-State-Forest, read 2026-10-21); the entry says 'not waterfront' and AWH's note says 'not directly on a lake or river' (which the view claim does not contradict, but a lakeview tier may apply).
